# fruitArchitecture

`fruitArchitecture` reconstructs and quantifies annotation-derived
signaling architectures from RNA-seq differential-expression evidence.
It supports two entry points:

- [`fruitArchitectureFromDEG()`](https://ensignanalytics.github.io/fruitArchitecture/reference/fruitArchitectureFromDEG.md)
  for an existing differential-expression table.
- [`fruitArchitecture()`](https://ensignanalytics.github.io/fruitArchitecture/reference/fruitArchitecture.md)
  for a raw count matrix analyzed with DESeq2.

Version 0.1.1 is an early research release. The package implements the
complete software workflow, but metric equations and class thresholds
remain explicitly versioned while they undergo reference-dataset
validation.

## Installation

### 1. Choose the local R library

R normally installs user packages into the first directory returned by
[`.libPaths()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/libPaths.html).

``` r

user_library <- .libPaths()[1]
dir.create(user_library, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
user_library
```

On Windows with R 4.5, this is commonly similar to:

``` text
C:/Users/<username>/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.5
```

### 2. Install from an extracted package project

Download the project ZIP, extract it, and point
[`remotes::install_local()`](https://remotes.r-lib.org/reference/install_local.html)
to the extracted directory containing `DESCRIPTION`.

``` r

if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("remotes", lib = user_library)
}

package_directory <- "C:/Users/<username>/Downloads/fruitArchitecture"

remotes::install_local(
  package_directory,
  lib = user_library,
  dependencies = c("Depends", "Imports", "LinkingTo"),
  upgrade = "never",
  force = TRUE
)
```

A project ZIP is not the same as a built Windows binary ZIP. Do not use
`type = "win.binary"` unless the file was created by
`R CMD INSTALL --build` or an equivalent binary-build service.

### 3. Install the optional raw-count dependency

The DEG-table workflow does not require DESeq2. The raw-count workflow
does.

``` r

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager", lib = user_library)
}

BiocManager::install(
  "DESeq2",
  lib = user_library,
  ask = FALSE,
  update = FALSE
)
```

### 4. Load and verify

``` r

library(fruitArchitecture, lib.loc = user_library)
packageVersion("fruitArchitecture")
supportedSpecies()
```

If Windows reports that `rlang.dll`, `glue.dll`, or `cli.dll` is locked,
close all R and RStudio sessions, remove any `00LOCK*` directories from
the user library, restart R, and reinstall those dependencies. A final
`* DONE (fruitArchitecture)` message means the package itself installed.

## Quick-start example using the included DEG table

The installed package includes a small synthetic dataset designed to
exercise all architecture levels and create reproducible example
figures.

``` r

library(fruitArchitecture)

example_directory <- system.file("extdata", package = "fruitArchitecture")

deg_table <- utils::read.csv(
  file.path(example_directory, "fruitArchitecture_example_deg.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

annotation <- utils::read.csv(
  file.path(example_directory, "fruitArchitecture_example_annotation.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

result <- fruitArchitectureFromDEG(
  deg_table = deg_table,
  annotation = annotation,
  species = "synthetic fruit example",
  alpha = 0.05,
  log2fc_threshold = 1,
  n_permutations = 5000,
  seed = 1234
)

result
summary(result)
```

Inspect the principal result tables:

``` r

result$module_summary
result$interface_summary
result$level3b_genes
result$metrics
result$null_model[c("method", "expected", "observed", "p_value")]
```

## Create sample figures

Each call returns a regular `ggplot2` object.

``` r

module_plot <- plot(result, type = "modules")
interface_plot <- plot(result, type = "interfaces")
null_plot <- plot(result, type = "null")

module_plot
interface_plot
null_plot
```

Export all standard figures and analysis tables:

``` r

output_directory <- file.path(
  getwd(),
  "fruitArchitecture_example_output"
)

exportArchitecture(
  result,
  directory = output_directory,
  prefix = "synthetic_example"
)

exportFigures(
  result,
  directory = file.path(output_directory, "figures"),
  formats = c("pdf", "png", "tiff"),
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)

list.files(output_directory, recursive = TRUE)
```

The output includes:

- a serialized `fruit_architecture` RDS object;
- differential-expression, gene-membership, module, interface, and
  summary CSVs;
- module-support, interface-support, and Level 3B null-distribution
  figures;
- vector PDF and high-resolution PNG/TIFF versions of each figure.

## Full raw-count workflow

This example uses the included six-sample count matrix. It requires
DESeq2.

``` r

library(fruitArchitecture)

example_directory <- system.file("extdata", package = "fruitArchitecture")

counts_data <- utils::read.csv(
  file.path(example_directory, "fruitArchitecture_example_counts.csv"),
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)
counts <- as.matrix(counts_data)
storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"

design <- utils::read.csv(
  file.path(example_directory, "fruitArchitecture_example_design.csv"),
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)
design$condition <- factor(
  design$condition,
  levels = c("immature", "ripe")
)

annotation <- utils::read.csv(
  file.path(example_directory, "fruitArchitecture_example_annotation.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

count_result <- fruitArchitecture(
  counts = counts,
  design = design,
  species = "synthetic fruit example",
  formula = ~ condition,
  contrast = c("condition", "ripe", "immature"),
  annotation = annotation,
  alpha = 0.05,
  log2fc_threshold = 1,
  n_permutations = 5000,
  seed = 1234
)

count_result
plot(count_result, type = "modules")
```

## Required input schemas

A DEG table must contain one row per unique gene and, by default, these
fields:

``` text
gene_id
log2_fold_change
adjusted_p_value
```

Annotation must be long format with one row per gene-module assignment:

``` text
gene_id    module
G1         Plant hormone signal transduction
G1         MAPK signaling
G1         Information exchange
```

Alternative DEG column names can be provided through `gene_id_col`,
`log2fc_col`, and `padj_col`.

## Development installation

Contributors working from the package root can use:

``` r

if (!requireNamespace("devtools", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("devtools")
}

devtools::document()
devtools::test()
devtools::check()
devtools::install()
```

See
[`vignette("getting-started", package = "fruitArchitecture")`](https://ensignanalytics.github.io/fruitArchitecture/articles/getting-started.md)
for the full installed-package workflow. After installation, the
complete example can also be run with
`demo("fruitArchitecture-example", package = "fruitArchitecture")`.

## Package manuals

After installation, open the long-form guides from R:

``` r

vignette("fruitArchitecture-user-manual", package = "fruitArchitecture")
vignette("function-data-reference", package = "fruitArchitecture")
```

The first is the full user manual. The second is a compact inventory of
public functions, returned-object components, package directories, and
the bundled synthetic example data.

When the package was installed without building vignettes, open the
installed static manuals directly:

``` r

browseURL(system.file(
  "manuals",
  "fruitArchitecture-user-manual.html",
  package = "fruitArchitecture"
))

browseURL(system.file(
  "manuals",
  "function-data-reference.html",
  package = "fruitArchitecture"
))
```

# Package index

## Main analysis

- [`fruitArchitecture()`](https://ensignanalytics.github.io/fruitArchitecture/reference/fruitArchitecture.md)
  : Reconstruct a signaling architecture from an RNA-seq count matrix
- [`fruitArchitectureFromDEG()`](https://ensignanalytics.github.io/fruitArchitecture/reference/fruitArchitectureFromDEG.md)
  : Reconstruct a signaling architecture from a differential-expression
  table

## Example workflow

- [`fruitArchitectureExample()`](https://ensignanalytics.github.io/fruitArchitecture/reference/fruitArchitectureExample.md)
  : Run the bundled fruitArchitecture example
- [`fruitArchitectureExampleData()`](https://ensignanalytics.github.io/fruitArchitecture/reference/fruitArchitectureExampleData.md)
  : Load the bundled fruitArchitecture example data

## Results and figures

- [`plot(`*`<fruit_architecture>`*`)`](https://ensignanalytics.github.io/fruitArchitecture/reference/plot.fruit_architecture.md)
  : Plot a fruit architecture result
- [`exportArchitecture()`](https://ensignanalytics.github.io/fruitArchitecture/reference/exportArchitecture.md)
  : Export architecture tables and metadata
- [`exportFigures()`](https://ensignanalytics.github.io/fruitArchitecture/reference/exportFigures.md)
  : Export standard package figures

## Species support

- [`supportedSpecies()`](https://ensignanalytics.github.io/fruitArchitecture/reference/supportedSpecies.md)
  : List species planned or available in the annotation registry
